text:
eli: FYI canary restore started failing after last night's IAM cleanup. Error: `kms:Decrypt AccessDenied` when the restore tries to open snapshot.

zoe: Did anyone rename roles? I moved infra-canary-restore -> infra-canary yesterday.

eli: That matches timeline. Agent logs show no CreateGrant recorded for the new principal. CloudTrail shows a CreateGrant for the old principal at 2024-11-20T23:12:11Z.

kms-bot: [alert] key alias/rdw-canary: increased decrypt failures (6 in 30m).

sam: Quick check: run `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/rdw-canary --region us-west-2` — if empty, recreate and test.

oncall: Also validate S3 object metadata for SSE headers; multipart retries previously dropped headers in some cases.

eli: list-grants returned []. Recreated grant and restore succeeded.

zoe: Root cause: role rename orphaned grants + agent doesn't persist grant ids. Risk: availability and audit gaps.

sam: Short-term: recreate grants when detected. Medium: backup-agent should persist grantId in snapshot metadata and emit metric on missing grant. Long-term: add RBAC-rename runbook (pre-rotation grant reconciliation) and CI checklist for IAM renames.

backup-bot: ticket SEC-2401 opened for tracking.

oncall: Actions: zoe create runbook PR; sam PR to agent to persist grantId; infra add pre-rotation script. Close when migration plan for legacy CMKs is posted.

eli: Notifying compliance to prepare auditor note explaining temporary unavailability. Thanks all.
